title: Story pack: Decoded #12 lands today (The Learning Loop)
hook: Most teams make ads and read dashboards. The learning either side gets skipped.
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

Announces Decoded #12: The Learning Loop: How to Run a Fortnightly Creative Cycle. Frame 1 is the issue title. Frame 2 lists the six steps of one cycle. Frame 3 is the poll. Frame 4 sends people to the issue with a link sticker.
alt_text: Four vertical story frames. Frame 1: Decoded #12, The Learning Loop: How to Run a Fortnightly Creative Cycle, out today. Frame 2 lists six steps in two weeks: decode, decide, brief, produce, run, review. Frame 3 is a poll asking how often your team reviews creative. Frame 4 asks people to read Decoded #12 free.
